label: Balance Test - Does the participant have any of the exclusion criteria? - Myofit sub-study
meta_rows: Balance Test - Does the participant have any of the exclusion criteria? - Myofit sub-study

Balance Test done in the Myofit sub-study. For those participants who were unable to do the test during the 2023 Home visit, they were asked to do the test during the Myofit clinic visit. These need to be merged with the 2023 HV and NOT the 2015 HV.
cat_rows: Study participants were asked by the attending nurse whether they would be willing to perform tests of standing balance.  If willing and able (reasons for inability included health reasons and equipment not available) two tests of standing balance were performed, one with eyes open and one with eyes closed. Participants who were unable to do the test during the 2023 Home visit were asked to when they took part in the Myofit (2020-2024) sub-study.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
